estimate.note: Estimated from the screenshot, not measured. The Vulnerable and Wrath-active figures were accepted. Vulnerable: War Cry makes enemies Vulnerable for 4s on a 15.09s cooldown (4/15.09 = 0.265076). Stone of Jordan makes a touched enemy Vulnerable for 10s and the screenshot gives no touch interval. The estimate uses War Cry's cooldown as the only printed cycle and one touch per cycle. The 4s War Cry window sits inside the 10s touch window, so the union is 10/15.09 = 0.662691. A faster touch rate is not in the screenshot and would raise this toward 1. Overpower: Wrath grants 1 stack per second for 15.8s on a 54.32s cooldown (15.8/54.32 = 0.290869). Each stack is 26%[+] and lasts 4s, up to 4 stacks. Full 4 stacks during Wrath is the working assumption. Stacks linger 4s after Wrath ends, still counted at 4 stacks. Overpower is on for (15.8+4)/54.32 = 0.364507. Earthstriker weapon-swap stacks are not added. Berserk uptime is not estimated. Channeling uptime is 1 while the scored skill is channeled. Whirlwind's channel bonus is 1%[x] per hit up to 25, and those stacks are reached fast, so the uptime is 1. The scored line is Aspect of Channeling 138%[x]. The codex 69%[x] effect stays on the aspect and is not applied with the imprint. The skill's 1%[x] per hit is not added on top of the 138%. Fury above 50 is 1, confirmed by the user, and is no longer an estimate. Max Fury 826, Fury regeneration 85, and +52.5% Fury generation are town values and may be higher in combat. Melted Heart's 30%[x] uses that uptime. The x35% Vulnerable multiplier stays a separate always-on line. Unstoppable for Tibault's 26%[x] includes the 5s after Unstoppable ends. Iron Skin's 3s duration is the estimate input; the screenshot shows Unstoppable and cooldown 8.45s and does not show the seconds. The Iron Skin window is (3+5)/8.45 = 0.946746. Wrath is Unstoppable for 15.8s on a 54.32s cooldown, so its window is (15.8+5)/54.32 = 0.382916. No phase between the two cycles is stored, so the union is 1 - (1 - 8/8.45) × (1 - 20.8/54.32) = 0.967138. Fortified uptime is 1. The user confirmed the character is almost always Fortified, so this value is no longer an estimate. The earlier stacking check stays as history: Rallying Cry grants Fortify equal to 15% of Maximum Life per cast. Life 473, so one cast is 70.95 Fortify. The Fortified rule used for that check is an assumption: Fortify is at least current Life. One cast is below 473. No decay rate is stored, so the grants stack and persist. 7 × 70.95 = 496.65, which clears 473. The screenshot does not restate Rallying Cry's cooldown. The video transcription of 25s is the ramp clock only: the 7th cast is 150s after the first. The +20% effectiveness line is not applied to the Fortify grant. Channeling and Unstoppable remain estimates. Vulnerable and Overpower remain estimates. Berserk stays unset. Healthy or Injured uptime is 0.7 and is an estimate. Healthy means the enemy is above 80% life, which is 20% of the life bar. Injured means the enemy is below 35% life, which is 35% of the life bar. The band from 35% to 80% gets neither Weapons Master nor Might. A boss taking damage uniformly over its life spends 0.20 + 0.35 = 0.55 of the fight in one of those two windows. Trash dies fast, so most of its time is still Healthy and a short slice is Injured. The working trash share is 0.85. An equal mix of that trash reading and the boss life-bar fraction is 0.5 × 0.85 + 0.5 × 0.55 = 0.70. Weapons Master 75%[x] and Might 26%[x] use this one uptime together. The screenshot sheet's vs Healthy 26% and vs Injured 26% join the additive sum once on this same window. An enemy is in only one of those states. Dust Devil uptime is 1 while the scored skill is Whirlwind. The catalog tooltip and the allocated Tornado upgrade say Whirlwind creates 2 Dust Devils at 510% each. The channel creates them continuously, so Twister's 4s buff stays up. That uptime is an estimate. Twister's 13%[x] uses it. Twister's 39.9%[x] Dust Devil damage and the 39.8%[+] per 5 Strength rate are not applied to the 386% hit. Consecutive same-weapon uptime is 1 for a channeled Whirlwind and is an estimate. It is used only for the alternate Flawless Technique reading of +45%[x] Critical Strike Damage for 4s. The headline score does not apply that 45%[x]. Marshal's screenshot reduces the active cooldown of other non-Shout skills by 2.0s. It does not reduce War Cry, so Vulnerable stays 10/15.09 = 0.662691. The level-70 video line that reduced other Shout cooldowns is not applied. Wrath 54.32s and Iron Skin 8.45s stay the tooltip cooldowns because a shout-cast rate is not stored. Elites uptime is 0.75 and is an estimate. Trash dies fast, so most damage time is on elites and the boss. Player Healthy uptime is 1 and is an estimate: the player is Healthy almost all of the time. Missing potions is 0 of a capacity of 4, an estimate for this near-immortal setup, so Imbiber's 5%[x] per missing potion has factor 1.

critAudit.note: Follow-up 2026-10-22. Headline crit factor is (A + 74.248) / A × (1 + sum of gear [x] crit) × each aspect, unique, or skill [x] crit. The sheet 7,424.8% already includes the base 50% (medium [E]), so the extra ×1.5 is off. Gear lines sum (medium-high [A]): Insight 310 + Deathshead 88 + Ramaladni 44 = 442%, factor 5.42. reading is the one switch for the low-confidence pair: headline, sheet-includes-gear-x, active-weapon (Whirlwind swings Deathshead, weapon-2, x88%), or sheet-includes-gear-x-active-weapon. The in-game test is unequip Insight and compare the sheet. Additive gear crit stays inside the sheet: Gohr's +50%, Stone of Jordan +65%, Insight +180%, Spirit +78%, Ramaladni's +75%. Crit chance lines stay inside sheet 100%. Wrath +17.8%[x] is not named Critical Strike Damage Multiplier; the stored note keeps it inside the sheet. Flawless Technique +45%[x] is a skill line and multiplies separately in the alternate. Sources: [A] https://d4guides.gg/en/guides/mechanics/damage-calculation-in-diablo-4-how-your-damage-works ; [E] https://diablo4.cc/us/Glossary ; [F] https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/d4/t/weapon-stats-and-weapons-used/47095.
